name: Reverb Listings
description: Search what is for sale on Reverb, the marketplace for new, used and vintage music gear, from Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot: listings by text, make, condition, price, year, category and country, listing details with shipping and return terms, categories, and shops with their listings. Read-only, no account or token.
instructions:
## Reverb Listings
This connector reads the **public side of the Reverb API** (`https://api.reverb.com/api`): what is for sale on Reverb, the marketplace for new, used and vintage musical instruments and audio gear. It searches listings, reads a listing, lists the product categories and reads a shop and what it sells. It needs no Reverb account and cannot buy, make offers or see orders. To manage your own Reverb shop (listings, orders, messages), use the **Reverb** connector, which works with a personal access token.

**Setup**: nothing to enter. Install the connector and it works. The calls are sent without a token, with the headers Reverb asks for (`Accept: application/hal+json`, `Accept-Version: 3.0` and a `User-Agent`).

**Where to start**: `reverb_listings_search_listings` with a `query` ("fender telecaster", "sm57") and the filters that fit: `make`, `condition` (new or used), `price_min` and `price_max`, `year_min` and `year_max`, `item_region` (where the item is) and `ships_to` (where it can be sent). The answer's `humanized_params` repeats in words how Reverb understood the search: check it when the results look off. `reverb_listings_get_listing` then gives the full description, shipping and return terms of one listing.

**Categories**: `reverb_listings_list_categories` returns every category with its `uuid`; pass one as `category_uuid` to the search ("Acoustic Guitars / 12-String", "Effects and Pedals / Delay").

**Shops**: every listing names its shop (`shop.slug`). `reverb_listings_get_shop` reads its profile, rating and policies; `reverb_listings_list_shop_listings` lists what it has for sale.

**Field notes**:
- Prices are objects with `amount` as a decimal string ("274.80"), `amount_cents`, `currency` and a ready-to-show `display`. `price` is the listing price and `buyer_price` what the buyer pays. They come in USD unless `display_currency` asks for another currency; `listing_currency` is the currency the seller listed in.
- `condition.display_name` is the grade of the item (Brand New, Mint, Excellent, Very Good, Good, Fair, Poor, Non Functioning). The `condition` filter only tells new from used.
- Results are paged, and Reverb stops at page 50 of a search however many listings match (`total` can be far higher). Narrow the search instead of paging deep.
- `year` is free text typed by the seller ("1978", "2009 - 2010", or empty).
- `description` in a listing is HTML.
- Give the user the `_links.web.href` of a listing: that is its page on reverb.com.
- Rate limit: Reverb documents 2,000 read requests per minute and 10,000 per 10 minutes per application, and answers 429 beyond that. It publishes no separate terms for calls without a token.
- The price guide is not offered: Reverb answers that this endpoint is no longer publicly available.
prerequisites: Nothing: no Reverb account and no token. To manage your own shop, use the Reverb connector instead.

verifyHints.403: Reverb refused the call. Some parts of its API are no longer public (the price guide); the listing search needs no token.
verifyHints.404: Reverb found no listing or shop with that id or slug; a sold or removed listing answers 404.
verifyHints.429: Reverb is limiting requests from this address (2,000 reads per minute). Wait a minute and try again.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Reverb is limiting requests from this address (2,000 reads per minute). Wait a minute and try again.

tools.name: reverb_listings_search_listings
tools.description: Search the public listings on Reverb, the marketplace for new, used and vintage music gear. Combine a free-text `query` with filters: make, condition, price range, year range, category, where the item is located and where it ships to. Returns `total`, `current_page`, `total_pages`, a sentence saying how the search was understood (`humanized_params`) and `listings`, each with id, make, model, year, finish, title, condition, price and buyer price (amount as a decimal string, currency), shop name and slug, shipping, and links to the photo and the page on reverb.com. Paged with `page` and `per_page`; Reverb serves at most 50 pages per search, so narrow the filters instead of paging deep.

query.description: Free text, as typed in the Reverb search box: "fender telecaster", "sm57", "moog matriarch".

make.description: Brand of the item, for example fender, gibson or roland.

condition.description: Only brand-new items, or only used ones (every used grade from mint to non-functioning).

price_min.description: Lowest price, in the display currency (USD unless `display_currency` is set).

price_max.description: Highest price, in the display currency (USD unless `display_currency` is set).

year_min.description: Earliest year the item was made, for example 1965.

year_max.description: Latest year the item was made, for example 1979.

category_uuid.description: Only listings in this category: a `uuid` from `reverb_listings_list_categories`.

item_region.description: Where the item is located: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code such as US, GB, DE or JP.

ships_to.description: Only listings that ship to this country: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as US, GB or DE.

sort.description: Order by price, lowest first (`price|asc`) or highest first (`price|desc`). Without it Reverb orders by relevance.

display_currency.description: Currency to show every price in, as an ISO 4217 code such as USD, EUR or GBP (sent as the `X-Display-Currency` header). Without it Reverb answers in USD.

tools.name: reverb_listings_get_listing
tools.description: Read one Reverb listing by its numeric id (the `id` of a search result): title, make, model, year, finish, the full description as HTML, condition, price and buyer price, how many are in stock, whether offers are accepted, where the item is (`location`), shipping rates and policy, return policy, the shop with its feedback count and rating, view and watch counts, photos and the link to the page on reverb.com. A listing that was removed answers 404.

listing_id.description: Numeric id of the listing, for example 102787080. The longer id-and-title form from a reverb.com link works too.

display_currency.description: Currency to show every price in, as an ISO 4217 code such as USD, EUR or GBP (sent as the `X-Display-Currency` header). Without it Reverb answers in USD.

tools.name: reverb_listings_list_categories
tools.description: List every Reverb product category as a flat list (about 320 entries): `uuid`, `full_name` with its parent (for example "Acoustic Guitars / 12-String"), `slug` and `root_slug`. Use a `uuid` as `category_uuid` in `reverb_listings_search_listings`. The list rarely changes, so read it once per conversation.

tools.name: reverb_listings_get_shop
tools.description: Read the public profile of a Reverb shop by its slug (the `shop.slug` of a listing, or the last part of a reverb.com/shop/ address): name, description, shop type, country, feedback count and rating, whether it is a preferred seller, a quick shipper or on vacation, and its shipping, payment and return policies.

shop_slug.description: Slug of the shop, for example the `shop.slug` field of a listing.

tools.name: reverb_listings_list_shop_listings
tools.description: List the live listings of one Reverb shop by its slug, optionally narrowed by a text query or a price range. Returns the same fields as the listing search: `total`, `total_pages` and `listings` with id, make, model, title, condition, price and links. Paged with `page` and `per_page`.

shop_slug.description: Slug of the shop, for example the `shop.slug` field of a listing.

query.description: Free text to search within the shop.

price_min.description: Lowest price, in the display currency (USD unless `display_currency` is set).

price_max.description: Highest price, in the display currency (USD unless `display_currency` is set).

sort.description: Order by price, lowest first (`price|asc`) or highest first (`price|desc`).

display_currency.description: Currency to show every price in, as an ISO 4217 code such as USD, EUR or GBP (sent as the `X-Display-Currency` header). Without it Reverb answers in USD.
